item.description: The variable 'method_name' is referenced before assignment in both set_hook_for_http2 and set_hook_for_http2_async functions. This causes an UnboundLocalError when trying to create HTTP2Record objects.
item.contract: Fix the order of operations in both hook functions so that the 'method_name' variable is assigned before it's used in the HTTP2Record constructor. The method name should be extracted from call arguments before creating the HTTP2Record object.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_hook_h2.py should pass without UnboundLocalError. Specifically, test_h2, test_h2_initiator, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_cookies, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_server, test_h2_server_only, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response, and test_h2_client_asyncclient should all pass.
